text: Table 1. Summary of studies focusing on neutralization of brain TNF-alpha with biologic TNF inhibitors in AD. Columns: biologic TNFI; species; route of administration; therapeutic effect. Row 1: Etanercept; Human; Perispinal; Cognitive improvement [45]. Row 2: Infliximab; Human; Intrathecal; Cognitive improvement, change in blood and CSF Aβ and tau [47]. Row 3 (Infliximab continued): Mouse; Intracerebroventricular; Reduction in Aβ pathology, tau phosphorylation, and cognitive deficits [42–44]. Row 4: Recombinant dominant negative TNFI; Mouse; Intrahippocampal; Reduction in Aβ pathology [35]. Abbreviations: Aβ amyloid beta; AD Alzheimer's disease; CSF cerebrospinal fluid; TNF-alpha tumor necrosis factor alpha; TNFI TNF-alpha inhibitor. Direction of biomarker change in row 2 is not specified.
